Self.Wiki: Occlusion portal (formerly Muffling Portal; the game's CSMsbPointOcclusionPortal; vanilla names: 遮蔽ポータル). An opening of an Occlusion Box. Routes reference portals by their Region ID, so keep Region IDs unique. The map's .onav file has one layer per portal, compiled from these regions.

BoxNumber.Wiki: The Box Number of the Occlusion Box (room) this portal belongs to. All 414 retail portals match a box in their map.
